title: Use a sort-key prefix
summary: A sort key can support a range or prefix inside one partition.
introduction: A sort key can support a range or prefix inside one partition. Your task: Change the prefix to garden.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for use a sort-key prefix

blocks.text: A sort key can support a range or prefix inside one partition. begins_with keeps keys that start with the supplied text.

Use DynamoDB Local and the AWS CLI or SDK in a separate practice project. Point every command at http://localhost:8000. Low-level JSON examples show request bodies; provide them to the matching CLI command or SDK method.
Read the code step by step

items: `KeyConditionExpression` uses the table or index keys to select a partition and, optionally, a sort-key range.
`ConditionExpression` checks the current item as part of the write, so a failed condition prevents the change.
`ExpressionAttributeNames` maps placeholders such as #reader to actual field names in the request expression.

blocks.text: Mia's moon-trip item matches the moon prefix.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The prefix test is on the sort key after choosing the partition. It is not a full-text title search.
